title: Took a beating and still won today
author: Zephyr_Labs
selftext:
This is day 7 of the paper trader executing from frozen logic.

Today:  
8 trades executed  
3 won  
5 lost

Total gross gained 1.6% for the day

4% since market open yesterday.

After it does this for a few weeks, I am going to get a quant to look at it and tell me if it’s a legitimate market edge or not.

comments.author: joshman1204
comments.body: Why not just live test it with a small account? You'll learn real quick if it works or not. Almost everything that works on paper dies in real life.

replies.author: Zephyr_Labs
replies.body: Honestly, haven’t had the money to put into it. It’s taking everything I have to not starve lately. Also the architecture would require a better physical setup than what I currently have. So paper trading is my only option currently.

replies.author: joshman1204
replies.body: Then you are wasting you time. You should focus on making money and building a savings. Even if you find the perfect strat what good is it with no funds?

comments.author: Downtown-Pianist-361
comments.body: I get what that comment means but 7 days is way too early for me to go live just because its green. I use Moon and one thing it taught me is that a good week can disappear fast. Id give the logic a few ugly market weeks first and see if it still behaves the same.

replies.author: Zephyr_Labs
replies.body: I’m giving it 30 clean sessions before I take it to a cash account. 7 great sessions is just exciting enough to give a lot of false hope.

replies.author: Weird_Cookie1700
replies.body:
What are you using to paper trade? That would be a determining factor on if the quant even acknowledges your trades.

Also, paper trading is not the same as real trading, by a long shot. I’ve had paper AI accounts that seem fine on paper but going live was another story entirely.
